# Small Business Deadline Calendar (First Mover Projects)

> Dated vendor and system changes that small businesses should check, each linked to the official source. One page per deadline with the date, who it affects, what to check, and a copy-paste checklist prompt. General guidance, not legal, tax or IT advice. Always confirm dates on the official source.

Run by First Mover Projects, PO Box 98, Firth, NE 68358. Contact: firstmoverprojects@gmail.com. Not affiliated with any vendor or agency named.

## Deadlines (upcoming)
- [ChatGPT custom GPTs scheduled to retire Dec 11, 2026; affected Enterprise workspaces: new GPT creation ended Oct 26, 2026 (FedRAMP exempt)](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/custom-gpt-retirement-dec-11.html): Anyone who created or relies on a custom GPT; creators can migrate GPTs to plugins. FedRAMP workspaces and affected Enterprise workspaces with a deferral from OpenAI retire Feb 11, 2027. A deferral alone does not preserve eligibility to create new GPTs. Source: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001519-custom-gpt-retirement-and-migration-faq
- [Custom GPT Retirement Checker (free, runs in your browser)](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/custom-gpt-retirement-checker/): Paste a custom GPT's settings to see which parts need attention before the scheduled Dec 11, 2026 retirement, with a countdown. No sign-up; nothing is sent anywhere.
- [EU product identifiers mandatory for low-value e-commerce imports, Nov 1, 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/eu-product-identifiers-nov-1.html): Sellers outside the EU shipping online orders up to EUR 150 to EU consumers, and whoever declares those parcels. Source: https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/news/guidance-and-legal-text-temporary-flat-fee-low-value-imports-which-will-apply-until-1-july-2028-2026-06-08_en
- [EU Nov 1 Product ID Quick Check (free, runs in your browser)](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/eu-product-id-check/): Paste up to 25 rows of merchant SKU, manufacturer product code and barcode and get a fix list. No sign-up; nothing is sent anywhere.
- [Amazon commercial liability insurance changes, Nov 2, 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/amazon-insurance-nov-2.html): Sellers in categories with enhanced safety listing requirements; sellers based in Mainland China. Source: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/seller-forums/discussions/t/287d5c33-8278-4802-ba69-2f58f7dda408
- [ZenBusiness Banking closure, deposits stop Nov 3, accounts close Nov 30, 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/zenbusiness-banking-closure.html): ZenBusiness Banking account holders. Source: https://help.zenbusiness.com/zenbusiness-banking/banking-closure-faq
- [IRS FIRE retirement, last filing day Nov 19, 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/irs-fire-retirement-nov-19.html): Filers who e-file 1099s through FIRE (Nov 1 test cutoff has passed; Nov 9, 2026 was the last day to make changes to FIRE IR Applications for TCC and those applications are now read-only). Source: https://www.irs.gov/e-file-providers/filing-information-returns-electronically-fire
- [How long does an IRIS TCC application take?](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/iris-tcc-application-how-long.html): Publication 5717 says to allow up to 45 calendar days for an IRIS Application for TCC, and you cannot transmit returns in the IRIS Taxpayer Portal until a TCC is assigned. Source: https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/p5717.pdf
- [What belongs on a FIRE to IRIS transition checklist?](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/fire-to-iris-transition-checklist.html): Key IRS dates (Nov 1, 2026 test cutoff, passed; Nov 9, 2026 last day to make changes to existing IR Applications for TCC, now read-only; Nov 19, 2026 at 3 p.m. ET last FIRE filing day; Jan 1, 2027 IRIS-only e-filing) and the separate IRIS Application for TCC. Source: https://www.irs.gov/e-file-providers/filing-information-returns-electronically-fire
- [How do you file Form 1099-NEC for 2027 in IRIS?](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/file-1099-nec-2027-iris.html): The IRS lists a $2,000 threshold for payments made in 2026 ($2,100 for calendar year 2027 under Rev. Proc. 2026-35 section 3.52), a January 31 due date, and IRIS as the only intake system beginning tax year 2026. Source: https://www.irs.gov/publications/p1099
- [Amazon Ads older Sponsored Ads and DSP reports pages retire, Dec 31, 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/amazon-ads-legacy-reports-dec-31.html): Amazon advertisers using saved or scheduled reports from the older pages. Source: https://advertising.amazon.com/resources/whats-new/streamline-campaign-analysis-with-unified-reporting
- [Exchange Online EWS fully and permanently disabled Apr 1, 2027; phased switch-off from Oct 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/exchange-online-ews-retirement-apr-1.html): Microsoft 365 admins whose apps, scripts or services still use EWS. Source: https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/exchange/exchange-online-ews-your-time-is-almost-up/4492361
- [When is Form 941 for the third quarter of 2026 due?](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/form-941-q3-due-nov-2.html): November 2, 2026, or November 10, 2026 if the quarter's deposits were on time and in full. FUTA owed through September, if more than $500, is also due November 2. Source: https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/fourth-quarter-tax-calendar
- [What federal small-business tax payments are due on December 15, 2026?](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/federal-tax-payments-dec-15.html): Corporate fourth estimated-tax installment, partnership Form 8813, and the November deposit for monthly employment-tax depositors. Sole proprietors' next Form 1040-ES date under Publication 509 is January 15, 2027. Source: https://www.irs.gov/publications/p509
- [Until when can customers return Amazon.com items bought in November and December 2026?](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/amazon-holiday-returns-2026.html): Purchases from November 1 through December 31, 2026 can be returned until January 31, 2027. Apple brand products until January 15, 2027. Source: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/seller-forums/discussions/t/fcc4e6f3-5e86-4b04-be84-82f9bcc2558a
- [When do eBay's updated U.S. Payments Terms of Use take effect?](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/ebay-payments-terms-nov-4.html): November 4, 2026 for sellers who have not already accepted the October 21, 2026 version. Source: https://ir.ebaystatic.com/cr/v/c01/us-payments-terms-of-use-2026-10-21b.pdf
- [What happens if you miss Pennsylvania's 2027 annual report?](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/pennsylvania-annual-report-2027.html): Beginning with reports due in 2027, a missed annual report can lead to administrative dissolution, cancellation, or termination six months after the due date, after notice. Corporations file by June 30, LLCs by September 30, and limited partnerships and similar associations by December 31. Fee on the state page: $7, or $0 for a nonprofit. File at file.dos.pa.gov. Source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dos/programs/business/types-of-filings-and-registrations/annual-reports
- [Texas franchise tax forfeiture and reinstatement, before January 29, 2027](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/texas-franchise-tax-forfeiture-reinstatement.html): The Comptroller began mailing the Texas Notice of Forfeiture of Right to Transact Business on September 29, 2026. Revive the right to transact business before January 29, 2027, or the Secretary of State registration is forfeited. Reinstatement uses Comptroller Form 05-391, then Secretary of State Form 801 ($75, or no fee for a nonprofit corporation). Source: https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/tax-policy-news/2026-october.php
- [Texas franchise tax forfeiture check (free, runs in your browser)](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/tx-franchise-forfeiture-check/): Four questions on revenue, what is still open, whether the Secretary of State has forfeited the entity, and the Form 801 fee. Nothing is uploaded.

## Past
- [Old Microsoft Whiteboards in Azure deleted, Oct 16, 2026 (just passed)](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/whiteboard-azure-oct-16.html): Work or school Whiteboards not migrated to OneDrive. Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/whiteboard/migration-of-whiteboards-from-azure-to-onedrive
- [Office 2021 and Windows 11 24H2 Home/Pro updates end, Oct 13, 2026](https://firstmoverprojects.com/deadlines/office-2021-windows-11-24h2-oct-13.html): Anyone still on Office 2021 or Windows 11 version 24H2 Home or Pro; support and security updates ended October 13, 2026. Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/system-requirements/end-of-support-for-office-2021

## Free browser tools
- [Amazon Nov 2 Insurance Certificate (COI) Pre-Check](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/amazon-coi-check/): Paste your certificate of insurance text to check 7 key terms against Amazon's $1M commercial liability insurance criteria and get a plain-text fix list for your broker. Runs in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
- [EWS Setting Decoder](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/ews-setting-decoder/): Paste the output of a read-only Exchange Online PowerShell command to see what Microsoft's phased EWS switch-off and Apr 1, 2027 permanent disable date mean for your tenant. Runs in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Etsy Real-Photo & Listing Audit Check](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/etsy-photo-audit-check/): Paste up to 10 listing rows, or toggle one listing, and get a current-risk column beside a real-photo fix plan. Runs in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
- [After-Hours Lead Capture Side-by-Side Scorecard](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/after-hours-gap-check/): Six questions plus your own inquiry, ticket, and close-rate numbers. Current setup beside an instant-capture checklist. Arithmetic uses only the numbers you enter.
- [Loom Seat Audit & Creator-Lite Migration Calculator](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/loom-seat-audit-calculator/): Paste a seat CSV or enter counts and your per-seat rate. Name and email columns are dropped. Annual arithmetic uses only your counts and rate.
- [Free 60-Second AI Agent Team & 12-Routine Savings Calculator](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/grok-bot-team-check/): Check which of 12 AI agent routines and 5 human-in-the-loop roles (Chief, Scout, Builder, Risk, Sales) save the most hours and money per week using your own inputs. Runs in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Free sample follow-up texts for local service businesses](https://firstmoverprojects.com/tools/missed-lead-text-samples/): Copy-paste sample follow-up texts for a missed call, a web form with no reply, and an appointment no-show, each ending with Reply STOP to opt out.

Says whether Form 1099-NEC is likely yours to file, whether the card company or payment app reports it on Form 1099-K, whether to file Form 1099-NEC only for the non-card portion, or whether no 1099 is likely needed. Runs in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
